name: Crypto Data API
summary: REST API for cryptocurrency market data covering 12 major coins, global market statistics, Fear & Greed, and sentiment freshness metadata.
pricingLabel: Free tier; Pro access by email request (payments disabled)
bestFor: Developers building crypto dashboards, market-monitoring tools, bots, and AI agent integrations.
limitation: Does not provide historical OHLCV candles or order-book depth. Sentiment data may be stale; inspect sentiment_stale.
description:
Crypto Data API is a keyless REST API for cryptocurrency market data.

**Endpoints**
- `GET /health`
- `GET /v1/market`
- `GET /v1/coin/{sym}`
- `GET /v1/fear-greed`
- `GET /v1/payment`

The service covers 12 major assets (BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, AVAX, LINK, DOT, TRX, LTC), global market statistics, and a Fear & Greed index.

**Freshness metadata**
Every response carries a `_meta` object so a consumer can judge the data before trusting it: `age_seconds` and `updated` for the market snapshot, `sentiment_age_minutes` and `sentiment_stale` for the sentiment block. The market snapshot is refreshed every 15 minutes. Sentiment is generated on a slower cadence and CAN BE STALE; when `sentiment_stale` is true, check the age before using it. Do not assume sentiment is always fresh.

**Access**
CORS is enabled (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, methods GET/HEAD/OPTIONS), so browser-side fetch works without a proxy. Free tier: 10 requests per minute per IP, no API key, no signup. Pro tier: 100 requests per minute with an API key, issued by email request only. Payment processing is NOT enabled, so there is no self-serve purchase.

**Not included**
No historical OHLCV candles, no order-book depth, no websocket stream, no uptime SLA.
